## Release check

- [ ] No private recordings, labels, credentials, paths, provider details, or
      unreviewed artifacts are included or linked.
- [ ] Tests and examples use synthetic, public, or expressly cleared material.
- [ ] Third-party sources, generated material, and notices are disclosed.
- [ ] User-visible behavior and limitations are documented.
- [ ] Claims follow `docs/EVIDENCE.md` and name the checked artifact or
      evaluation.
- [ ] Every commit includes my DCO `Signed-off-by` line.
